summary: Atour Lifestyle Holdings Ltd filed its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 with the SEC on April 17, 2026, via Form 6-K. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of audited financial results, not a special situation. No transaction, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is announced. The press release merely confirms filing availability and provides access instructions.
